title: Creator Launch OS
promise: Deploy a clear multi-product storefront with an honest checkout handoff and a built-in release studio.

core.name: Free core
includes: Deployable Next.js storefront, catalog and product pages
Honest checkout handoff with a no-payment preview
Merchant-agnostic commerce adapter with a fixture test mode
Sample release studio and six editable template studies
Contract tests, CI and a reproducible release package

kit.name: Commercial Kit
includes: Launch playbook from fresh clone to first paid order
Product, listing and offer manifest pack
Merchant integration guide for the commerce adapter
excludes: A live merchant adapter until one merchant is chosen and reviewed
Hosting, merchant fees or a merchant account
